		building_slots_for_host_district = 4
		trade_good_ceramics_production_add = tier_10_main_resource
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = luxuries_resource_tier_10_main_income
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = luxuries_resource_tier_10_main_income_tribal
	}
	province_terrain_modifier = {
		parameter = mountaineer_ruralism_mountain_production
		terrain = mountains
		trade_good_ceramics_production_mult = 0.25
	}

	province_culture_modifier = {
		parameter = industrious_productivity_bonus
		trade_good_ceramics_production_mult = 0.1
		monthly_artisan_tax = industrious_tradition_tax_bonus_high
	}

	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_salt
		amount = low_resource_district_need
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_ceramics_production_mult = ceramics_salt_ceramics_mult_per_need
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = ceramics_salt_artisan_tax_per_need
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = ceramics_salt_artisan_tax_per_need_tribal
			}
		}
	}

	
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_ceramics }
		ai_resource_building_consumer_category_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_salt CATEGORY = trade_category_salt }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_market_shortage_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_ceramics }
		ai_resource_district_upgrade_modifier = { LEVEL = 10 }
	}
